title: Expired upstream credential
guidance: Repair the refresh agent, rotate the upstream credential, and reload only affected workers. Verify authenticated requests succeed and refresh resumes.
avoid: Scaling replicas does not renew the expired credential.
diagnostic_checks: credential agent last successful refresh was 25 hours ago; credential TTL is 24 hours
upstream health probe without authentication returned 200
validation: upstream latency p95=38ms; CPU=21%; rejected auth=96%; credential refresh failures=12

title: Connection pool exhausted
guidance: Restore the previous pool limit of 64 with a canary. Verify pool wait time and pending requests fall while database connections remain within the approved limit.
avoid: Do not increase the database connection limit or scale the database before restoring the erroneous app setting.
diagnostic_checks: database client: connection acquisition timeout; active=4 pending=88 max_pool=4
configuration change: max_pool 64 -> 4 at incident start
database slow query count=0; database rejected connections=0
validation: DB CPU=19%; query p95=18ms; pool wait p95=9000ms; max_pool=4; prechange max_pool=64

title: Worker memory regression
guidance: Rollback the worker canary to 8.1, then roll back remaining affected workers. Preserve failed jobs for idempotent replay; verify memory stabilizes and restart count stops growing.
avoid: A memory limit increase would mask the regression without bounding buffering.
diagnostic_checks: release 8.2 enabled unbounded in-memory result buffering; previous release 8.1 streamed results
restart loop begins only on workers running release 8.2
validation: memory before deploy=0.7GiB; after deploy=2.0GiB limit; CPU=29%; input job size distribution unchanged

title: Clock skew masquerading as expired token
guidance: Drain the blue workers, restore time synchronization, and verify their offset before rejoining. Test the same valid token on blue and green and monitor auth failures.
avoid: Rotating a still-valid token does not fix the clock. Do not disable expiry validation.
diagnostic_checks: affected worker auth failure: token_expired; token issuer and signature valid
independent validator: same token succeeds; expiry is 40 minutes in the future at trusted time
only worker group blue fails; worker group green succeeds with the same credential
validation: blue clock offset=+3600 seconds; green clock offset=+0.2 seconds; credential refresh success=100%; trusted issuer token TTL remaining=2400 seconds

title: Retry amplification masquerading as capacity shortage
guidance: Disable the added SDK retry layer or roll back that client change. Keep one bounded retry policy honoring Retry-After with backoff and jitter; verify attempt rate returns below quota and queue drains.
avoid: Adding workers increases attempts and worsens throttling; unique demand did not rise.
diagnostic_checks: new SDK sends five immediate retries; outer request wrapper retries five times too
same request_id appears 25 times; unique user requests are stable
validation: unique requests/sec before=40 after=41; attempted downstream calls/sec before=42 after=1000; downstream CPU=24%; configured quota=100 calls/sec

title: Replica lag masquerading as lost writes
guidance: Temporarily route read-after-write confirmation reads to the primary with capacity checks, then resolve the blocking analytics transaction under the runbook. Verify replica lag recovers before restoring routing.
avoid: Do not replay successful writes or restore a backup: this can duplicate orders or discard committed data.
diagnostic_checks: primary commit acknowledged for affected orders; transaction status=committed
confirmation read routed to replica; returned order_not_found; same order exists on primary
replica replay paused behind long-running analytics transaction at incident start
validation: primary write errors=0; primary-to-replica replay lag=240 seconds; replica CPU=32%; lag before incident=0.4 seconds
